id-emis-login-invalid: EMIS login must be a number of 5 to 12 digits.
id-emis-login-not-found: No account is linked to this EMIS login.

id-account-locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {retry_after} s.

id-challenge-used: This sign-in request was already handled. Continue where you left off.

id-hydra-unavailable: The sign-in service is not responding. Try again later.

id-mail-notice-not-you: If this was not you, change your password and log out everywhere.
id-password-unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
id-photo-too-large: The photo is too large. The limit is {max_mb} MB.
id-photo-type-not-allowed: The photo must be a JPG or PNG image.

id-password-login-disabled: Password sign-in is turned off for this account. Sign in with a passkey.

id-totp-state: The authenticator app is already in this state.
